reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text:
I used to use this app on a daily basis for YEARS, ever since 2014. Around 3 years ago, I started leaving Kik and today, I no longer want anything to do with this platform. Kik had always been terrible in regards to illegal things going on, even before the change in ownership. However, the new owners seem to prioritize live streaming over minors that use this platform. When the live streaming was first implemented, I saw an account that had blatant cp as the profile picture, and reporting won’t do anything. The new owners have shown to prioritize profit over the safety of its users. There are countless groups on Kik that engage in illegal activities, such as sharing cp, doxxing, and worse. I came across a community for MAPs (minor attracted people) who were so giddy about talking about “im saying x or y child” 

This platform is a complete danger chamber. If you are a parent, do not allow your child to use this platform. If I had to pick between which platform is worse between Roblox and Kik, it’s 100% kik

reviews.text: What a terrible buggy app. Full of bots. Since the updates. It loads for 2 seconds then hangs and crashes. If it wasnt for some of my friends around the world only available on this app i wouldve deleted it. The irony they want us to subscribe to a ad free app yet the standard one hardly works without major issues. Fix up kik before you lose more users.
